summary.oneLiner: Independent, home-grown Indian alternative asset management company operating under the "Gaja Capital" brand, acting as investment manager to India-focused Category II and Category I AIFs and as advisor to offshore funds, with 20 years of vintage in the mid-market private equity segment.
summary.business: The Company manages and advises India-focused alternative investment funds (the Gaja Capital Funds — Fund II formed 2007, Fund III 2015 and Fund IV 2021) plus a newly launched Secondaries Fund, providing growth capital to mid-market Portfolio Companies in EEE, financial services, consumer and digital technology.
